comments.runtimeDeps: Deliberately just next + react. The design is hand-authored CSS reproduced verbatim (plan §6.3) — no Tailwind, no CSS-in-JS, no component library, no animation library. Every visual is either lifted CSS, inline SVG, or a canvas ported from the design. Adding a UI dependency here needs a decision recorded in docs/DECISIONS.md.
comments.noPayloadDependency: This app must never depend on the payload packages. It talks to the CMS over HTTP only. The single crossing artifact is payload-types.ts, which CI copies from cms/ into lib/.
comments.pins: next, react and react-dom pinned exactly to stay inside Payload's supported Next range — the two apps must agree on the Next version.
comments.parity: `parity` runs the four-layer design-fidelity harness in tools/visual-parity. Baselines are versioned; updating one is an explicit reviewed commit.
comments.testDeps: jsdom + @testing-library/react + @vitejs/plugin-react are the plan-sanctioned component-test stack (§9.1). @playwright/test + @axe-core/playwright drive E2E and accessibility (§9.2, §9.3). pixelmatch + pngjs back the parity harness pixel layer (§9.4). All devDependencies — none ship to the browser.
